name: Form — MAS Deployment Health Check
description: Native n8n 2.30.8 deployment readiness form. Live probes: task/trace Data Tables, Orchestrator status, Trace Writer, and Docker HTTP health for excel-tools, n8n-runners, mas-activity, n8n. Report shows PASS/FAIL with where_to_fix.

parameters.content:
## MAS Deployment Health Check (n8n 2.30.8)
1. Select task + trace Data Tables in the two Probe nodes.
2. Bind Call Orchestrator probe → Orchestrator — Engineering MAS.
3. Bind Call Trace Writer probe → Writer — MAS Trace.
4. Live HTTP pings: excel-tools, n8n-runners, mas-activity, n8n /healthz (Docker DNS).
5. Publish/Test this form and read the HTML report.
6. Every FAIL line includes where_to_fix.

Full runbook: docs.md

parameters.formDescription: Run control-plane readiness probes. Bind this form's Data Table probes and Execute Workflow probes first (see sticky note / docs.md). Does not call LLM, Excel, or SCHEDULE Builder.

const prepared = $('Prepare health probes').first().json || {};
return [{ json: { ...prepared, _after: 'task_dt' } }];
